case.question: In Tears of Steel, one member of the team wears a mechanical eyepiece over one eye. What colour is the leather jacket he wears when he is asked how it is looking, and which actor plays him according to the closing credits?
case.answer_a: He wears a black leather jacket. He is the Captain, and the closing credits list the Captain as played by Rogier Schippers.
case.answer_b: He wears a red leather jacket. He is Barley, and the closing credits list Barley as played by Sergio Hasselbaink.
